text: ScalaFIM latent neuroarchive subsystem epic complete for the current scope: pure typed LNA contract, validation, quant/delta/basis/embed/explicit latent archives, manifest codec, JVM HDF5 store with checksum verification, dataset access, docs, fixtures/tests, and verified archive/dataset/compileAll pass. Native unsigned HDF5 integer emission remains an optional future backend/fork concern, not required for current ScalaFIM archive semantics.
